passages.text: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
passages.sermon:
Dinah was the daughter of Leah.
Leah gave birth to Dinah for Jacob.
Dinah went out.
She went to visit the daughters of the land.
passages.original: וַתֵּצֵ֤א דִינָה֙ בַּת־ לֵאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב לִרְא֖וֹת בִּבְנ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
passages.sermon:
Shechem was the son of Hamor.
Hamor was a Hivite.
Shechem was the prince of the region.
Shechem saw Dinah.
He took Dinah.
He lay with Dinah by force.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אֹתָ֜הּ שְׁכֶ֧ם בֶּן־ חֲמ֛וֹר הַֽחִוִּ֖י נְשִׂ֣יא הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אֹתָ֖הּ וַיְעַנֶּֽהָ׃

passages.text: And his soul was drawn to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly.
passages.sermon:
Shechem was the son of Hamor the Hivite.
Shechem was the prince of the region.
Shechem’s soul was drawn to Dinah.
Dinah was the daughter of Jacob.
Shechem loved the young girl.
Shechem spoke tenderly to her.
passages.original: וַתִּדְבַּ֣ק נַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּדִינָ֖ה בַּֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֶּֽאֱהַב֙ אֶת־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־ לֵ֥ב הַֽנַּעֲרָֽ׃

passages.text: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
passages.sermon:
Shechem was the son of Hamor.
Hamor was a Hivite.
Hamor was the prince of the region.
Shechem spoke to his father.
Shechem said to Hamor, "Get me this girl as a wife."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁכֶ֔ם אֶל־ חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר קַֽח־ לִ֛י אֶת־ הַיַּלְדָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, but since his sons were with his livestock in the field, he remained silent about it until they returned.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was Dinah’s father.
Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled Dinah.
Jacob’s sons were not at home.
Jacob’s sons were in the field with his livestock.
Jacob did not speak about what happened.
Jacob waited until his sons returned.
passages.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֣ב שָׁמַ֗ע כִּ֤י טִמֵּא֙ אֶת־ דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וּבָנָ֛יו הָי֥וּ אֶת־ מִקְנֵ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְהֶחֱרִ֥שׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב עַד־ בֹּאָֽם׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, Shechem’s father Hamor came to speak with Jacob.
passages.sermon:
Hamor was Shechem’s father.
Shechem had defiled Dinah, who was Jacob’s daughter.
Hamor went to Jacob.
Hamor wanted to speak with Jacob.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֛א חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־ שְׁכֶ֖ם אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְדַבֵּ֖ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When Jacob’s sons heard what had happened, they returned from the field. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
passages.sermon:
Jacob had sons.
Jacob’s sons were in the field with his livestock.
Shechem had defiled Dinah, who was Jacob’s daughter.
Jacob’s sons heard what Shechem had done.
Jacob’s sons returned from the field.
The men were very sad.
The men were very angry.
Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel.
Shechem had lain with Jacob’s daughter.
Such a thing should not be done.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֨י יַעֲקֹ֜ב בָּ֤אוּ מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶה֙ כְּשָׁמְעָ֔ם וַיִּֽתְעַצְּבוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹ֑ד כִּֽי־ נְבָלָ֞ה עָשָׂ֣ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ בַּֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכֵ֖ן לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
passages.sermon:
Hamor was Shechem’s father.
Hamor spoke to Jacob and his sons.
Hamor said, “My son is Shechem.
Shechem deeply desires your daughter.
Please give your daughter to Shechem as his wife.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר חֲמ֖וֹר אִתָּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנִ֗י חָֽשְׁקָ֤ה נַפְשׁוֹ֙ בְּבִתְּכֶ֔ם תְּנ֨וּ נָ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters, and take our daughters for yourselves.
passages.sermon:
Hamor spoke to Jacob’s sons.
Hamor invited them to join his people through marriage.
He said, “Give your daughters to us as wives.
Take our daughters for yourselves as wives.”
passages.original: וְהִֽתְחַתְּנ֖וּ אֹתָ֑נוּ בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ־ לָ֔נוּ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.”
passages.sermon:
Hamor spoke to Jacob and his sons.
Hamor invited them to live with his people.
He said, "You may settle among us."
He said, "The land will be open to you."
He told them, "Live here."
He told them, "Move about freely."
He told them, "Acquire your own property here."
passages.original: וְאִתָּ֖נוּ תֵּשֵׁ֑בוּ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּסְחָר֔וּהָ וְהֵֽאָחֲז֖וּ בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Grant me this favor, and I will give you whatever you ask.
passages.sermon:
Shechem was the son of Hamor.
Shechem spoke to Dinah’s father and brothers.
Shechem said, “Please show me favor.
I will give you whatever you ask.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁכֶם֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֣יה וְאֶל־ אַחֶ֔יהָ אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֛וּ אֵלַ֖י אֶתֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!”
passages.sermon:
Shechem spoke to Dinah’s father and brothers.
Shechem wanted to marry Dinah.
Shechem said, “Ask me for a large dowry.
Ask me for an expensive gift.
I will give you whatever you ask.
Just give me the girl to be my wife.”
passages.original: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּמַתָּ֔ן וְאֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י וּתְנוּ־ לִ֥י אֶת־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully.
passages.sermon:
Jacob had sons.
Shechem had defiled Dinah.
Dinah was their sister.
Shechem and his father Hamor spoke to Jacob’s sons.
Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and Hamor.
Jacob’s sons spoke deceitfully.
They spoke deceitfully because Shechem had defiled Dinah.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֨ם וְאֶת־ חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֛יו בְּמִרְמָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֑רוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר טִמֵּ֔א אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֥ה אֲחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: “We cannot do such a thing,” they said. “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
passages.sermon:
Jacob’s sons spoke to Shechem and Hamor.
They said, “We cannot do this thing.
We cannot give our sister to a man who is uncircumcised.
This would bring disgrace to us.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לֹ֤א נוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ אֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ לְאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ עָרְלָ֑ה כִּֽי־ חֶרְפָּ֥ה הִ֖וא לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.
passages.sermon:
Jacob’s sons spoke to Shechem and Hamor.
Jacob’s sons set a condition.
They said, “We will agree to your request only if you do one thing.”
You must become like us.
Every male among you must be circumcised.
passages.original: אַךְ־ בְּזֹ֖את נֵא֣וֹת לָכֶ֑ם אִ֚ם תִּהְי֣וּ כָמֹ֔נוּ לְהִמֹּ֥ל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃

passages.text: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.
passages.sermon:
We are the sons of Jacob.
We will give our daughters to you.
We will take your daughters for ourselves.
We will live with you.
We will become one people with you.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֤נּוּ אֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נִֽקַּֽח־ לָ֑נוּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֖ינוּ לְעַ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob’s sons spoke to Hamor and Shechem.
They said, “You must agree to be circumcised like us.
If you do not listen to us and become circumcised,
we will take our sister back.
We will leave.”
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֧א תִשְׁמְע֛וּ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ לְהִמּ֑וֹל וְלָקַ֥חְנוּ אֶת־ בִּתֵּ֖נוּ וְהָלָֽכְנוּ׃

passages.text: Their offer seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
passages.sermon:
Hamor was the father of Shechem.
Hamor listened to the offer.
Shechem, his son, also listened to the offer.
Hamor liked the offer.
Shechem liked the offer.
passages.original: וַיִּֽיטְב֥וּ דִבְרֵיהֶ֖ם בְּעֵינֵ֣י חֲמ֑וֹר וּבְעֵינֵ֖י שְׁכֶ֥ם בֶּן־ חֲמֽוֹר׃

passages.text: The young man, who was the most respected of all his father’s household, did not hesitate to fulfill this request, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
passages.sermon:
The young man was Shechem.
Shechem was the most respected in his father Hamor’s household.
Shechem did not hesitate to do what was asked.
He wanted Jacob’s daughter very much.
He acted quickly to fulfill the request.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ אֵחַ֤ר הַנַּ֙עַר֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַדָּבָ֔ר כִּ֥י חָפֵ֖ץ בְּבַֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְה֣וּא נִכְבָּ֔ד מִכֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed the men of their city: “These men are at peace with us. Let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.
passages.sermon:
Hamor was a leader in the city.  
Shechem was Hamor’s son.  
Hamor and Shechem went to the gate of their city.  
They spoke to the men of their city.  
They said, “These men are at peace with us.”  
“They can live in our land.”  
“They can trade in our land.”  
“Our land is large enough for them.”  
“We will take their daughters as wives.”  
“We will give our daughters to them.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א חֲמ֛וֹר וּשְׁכֶ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶל־ שַׁ֣עַר עִירָ֑ם וַֽיְדַבְּר֛וּ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י עִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗נוּ וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְיִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ הִנֵּ֥ה רַֽחֲבַת־ יָדַ֖יִם לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־ בְּנֹתָם֙ נִקַּֽח־ לָ֣נוּ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ נִתֵּ֥ן לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
passages.sermon:
The men of the city spoke to the people at the gate.
They said, “The men will agree to live with us only on one condition.
We want to become one people with them.
Every male among us must be circumcised.
We must do as they do.
If we do this, they will live with us.
We will become one people.”
passages.original: אַךְ־ בְּ֠זֹאת יֵאֹ֨תוּ לָ֤נוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אִתָּ֔נוּ לִהְי֖וֹת לְעַ֣ם אֶחָ֑ד בְּהִמּ֥וֹל לָ֙נוּ֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֵ֥ם נִמֹּלִֽים׃

passages.text: Will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.”
passages.sermon:
Hamor and his son Shechem spoke to the men of their city.
They said, “Their livestock will belong to us.
Their possessions will belong to us.
All their animals will belong to us.
Let us agree to their request.
Then they will live with us.”
passages.original: מִקְנֵהֶ֤ם וְקִנְיָנָם֙ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֔ם הֲל֥וֹא לָ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם אַ֚ךְ נֵא֣וֹתָה לָהֶ֔ם וְיֵשְׁב֖וּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
passages.sermon:
All the men of the city went out through the city gate.
Hamor was a leader in the city.
Shechem was Hamor’s son.
The men listened to Hamor and Shechem.
Every male in the city agreed with them.
Every male in the city was circumcised.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶל־ חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶל־ שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ כָּל־ יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר עִיר֑וֹ וַיִּמֹּ֙לוּ֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר כָּל־ יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֥עַר עִירֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Three days later, while they were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons (Dinah’s brothers Simeon and Levi) took their swords, went into the unsuspecting city, and slaughtered every male.
passages.sermon:
Jacob had sons named Simeon and Levi.
Dinah was their sister.
Three days passed after the men of the city were circumcised.
The men of the city were still in pain.
Simeon and Levi each took a sword.
They went into the city.
The people in the city did not expect danger.
Simeon and Levi killed every male in the city.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֣ם כֹּֽאֲבִ֗ים וַיִּקְח֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ בְנֵי־ יַ֠עֲקֹב שִׁמְע֨וֹן וְלֵוִ֜י אֲחֵ֤י דִינָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ חַרְבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַל־ הָעִ֖יר בֶּ֑טַח וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃

passages.text: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
passages.sermon:
Simeon and Levi were sons of Jacob.
Dinah was their sister.
Simeon and Levi killed Hamor with their swords.
They killed Shechem, Hamor’s son, with their swords.
They took Dinah from Shechem’s house.
They left the city.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ הָרְג֖וּ לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיִּקְח֧וּ אֶת־ דִּינָ֛ה מִבֵּ֥ית שְׁכֶ֖ם וַיֵּצֵֽאוּ׃

passages.text: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
passages.sermon:
Jacob had other sons.
These sons saw the dead bodies in the city.
They entered the city.
They looted the city.
They did this because someone had defiled their sister.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּ֚אוּ עַל־ הַ֣חֲלָלִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ הָעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר טִמְּא֖וּ אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: They took their flocks and herds and donkeys, and everything else in the city or in the field.
passages.sermon:
Jacob’s sons took the flocks.
They took the herds.
They took the donkeys.
They took everything in the city.
They took everything in the field.
passages.original: אֶת־ צֹאנָ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּקָרָ֖ם וְאֶת־ חֲמֹרֵיהֶּ֑ם וְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּעִ֛יר וְאֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָקָֽחוּ׃

passages.text: They carried off all their possessions and women and children, and they plundered everything in their houses.
passages.sermon:
Jacob’s sons entered the city after the slaughter.
They took all the people’s possessions.
They captured all the women.
They took all the children.
They plundered everything in the houses.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵילָ֤ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַיָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land. We are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of Simeon and Levi.
Jacob spoke to Simeon and Levi.
Jacob said, “You have brought trouble on me.
You have made me hated by the people who live in this land.
The Canaanites and the Perizzites live here.
We are few in number.
If they gather together against me and attack me, they will defeat me.
I and my household will be destroyed.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־ שִׁמְע֣וֹן וְאֶל־ לֵוִי֮ עֲכַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִי֒ לְהַבְאִישֵׁ֙נִי֙ בְּיֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּבַפְּרִזִּ֑י וַאֲנִי֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר וְנֶאֶסְפ֤וּ עָלַי֙ וְהִכּ֔וּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י אֲנִ֥י וּבֵיתִֽי׃

passages.text: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
passages.sermon: Simeon and Levi spoke.\r\nThey answered Jacob.\r\nThey said, “He should not treat our sister like a prostitute.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֑וּ הַכְזוֹנָ֕ה יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־ אֲחוֹתֵֽנוּ׃פ
